answer: Each identity must grow a personal work vine of delayed, memory-hard challenges whose seed is bound to that key; progress cannot be transferred or precomputed in a burst. Thin or copied traces are marked umber and receive no emission until the vine has aged through several epochs. The zenith of bidding power is reserved for traces that diverge from every other public trace. An attacker who spins many sybils must provision separate memory, wall-clock time, and energy for each vine; shared hardware makes traces collide and all of them get slashed.
